'''''BKFC Knucklemania V'''''  was a [[bare-knuckle fighting]] event held by Bare Knuckle Fighting Championship on January 25, 2025.<ref>{{Cite web |title=BKFC KNUCKLEMANIA V |url=https://www.bkfc.com/events/bkfc-knucklemania-v:2cd142cc-0366-4299-830f-83cf7bec4580 |access-date=2024-11-20 |website=Bare Knuckle Fighting Championships}}</ref>

===Background===
A bout between former [[List of UFC champions#Lightweight Championship|UFC Lightweight Champion]] (also former two-time [[List of Bellator MMA champions#Lightweight World Championship|Bellator Lightweight Champion]] and [[Bellator Fighting Championships: Season One#Lightweight Tournament Bracket|Bellator Season 1 Lightweight Tournament Winner]]) [[Eddie Alvarez]] and [[Jeremy Stephens]] headlined the event.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://mmajunkie.usatoday.com/2024/11/bkfc-knucklemania-5-eddie-alvarez-vs-jeremy-stephens-booked|title=Eddie Alvarez books hometown BKFC KnuckleMania 5 fight vs. Jeremy Stephens|publisher=mmajunkie.usatoday.com|author=Danny Segura|date=2024-11-19|access-date=2024-11-19}}</ref> A [[Bare Knuckle Fighting Championship#Heavyweight Championship|BKFC World Heavyweight Championship]] bout between champion [[Mick Terrill]] and [[Ben Rothwell]] took place at the event.<ref name="KnucklemaniaV"/>

Influencer [[Bryce Hall]] was scheduled compete at this event against Kevin Ferguson Jr. (Kimbo Slice Jr.).<ref name="KnucklemaniaV">{{Cite web|url=https://www.mmafighting.com/2024/12/3/24312245/kimbo-slice-jr-set-to-fight-bryce-hall-at-bkfc-knucklemania-5|title=Kimbo Slice Jr. set to fight Bryce Hall at BKFC KnuckleMania 5|publisher=mmafighting.com|author=Alexander K. Lee|date=2024-12-03|access-date=2024-12-03}}</ref> However, Ferguson Jr. pulled out for unknown reasons and the bout was scrapped.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://mmajunkie.usatoday.com/2025/01/bkfc-knucklemania-5-bryce-hall-vs-baby-slice-removed|title=Bryce Hall vs. 'Baby Slice' removed from BKFC: KnuckleMania 5 lineup|publisher=mmajunkie.usatoday.com|author=Nolan King and Mike Bohn|date=2025-01-07|access-date=2025-01-07}}</ref>

Dustin Pague and JD Burns were scheduled to compete at this event but the bout was scrapped due to medical reasons.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.instagram.com/p/DFN1chTxnKO/|author=JD Burns|title=Instagram |date=2025-01-24|access-date=2025-01-25}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://cagesidepress.com/2025/03/17/dustin-pague-hyped-to-main-event-bkfc-fn-philly-after-knucklemania-cancelation/|title=Dustin Pague Hyped To Main Event BKFC FN: Philly After Knucklemania Cancelation|publisher=cagesidepress.com|author=Eddie Law|date=2025-03-17|access-date=2025-03-17}}</ref>
